name: ethiopia-chain-zk-voting
description: Backend-only research prototype for ZK voting with Circom, Groth16, and Solidity.

scripts.compile: cross-env HARDHAT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY_PROMPT=true npm run zk:setup && cross-env HARDHAT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY_PROMPT=true hardhat compile
scripts.test: npm run compile && cross-env HARDHAT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY_PROMPT=true hardhat test
scripts.deploy:local: npm run compile && cross-env HARDHAT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY_PROMPT=true hardhat run scripts/deploy.js
